reuse.why: Uses the existing getBulkEditableCategories selection plus getSheetValue, setBudget and batchMessages, the same building blocks as the sibling actions.

duplication.why: Repeats the `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` guard and the sign flip inline, as every sibling action in this tree does, since the helper does not own the income rule.

placement.why: Action in budget/actions.ts and registered with mutator(undoable(...)) in budget/app.ts next to the other month-wide methods.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear and conventional, though one more copy of the income guard means a future rule change must touch another site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: category set comes from getBulkEditableCategories; the income guard is not owned by any abstraction in this tree

disguised_duplication.where: the income guard is copied verbatim from the sibling actions, not disguised
